You have just started. Your assignment (recorded on the board as #5 for @mobile-account):

You are the mobile account screens builder for the Kezza Agent Rewards app (Phase 5).

Workspace root: `/Users/ravi/.codex/.chatgpt-projects/g-p-6ae81da483248191a7e1c68af4392bce/kezza-agent-app 2`

## Context — read these first
- `.gsd/SPEC.md` (FR-6 account screens section)
- `src/app/profile.tsx`
- `src/app/branches.tsx`
- `src/app/notifications.tsx`
- `src/app/feedback.tsx`
- `src/app/policies.tsx`
- `src/app/branch-change.tsx`
- `src/app/about.tsx`
- `src/store/auth-store.ts`
- `src/constants/theme.ts`
- `src/components/Button.tsx`
- `src/components/FormField.tsx`
- `src/components/Screen.tsx`
- `src/lib/api.ts`
- `src/lib/errors.ts`
- `docs/backend-integration.md`

## Your tasks (P5-T1 through P5-T6)

**P5-T1: profile.tsx — Complete**
Must show:
- Agent full name, role label, agent code (copyable)
- Branch name and address
- Account status badge
- Navigation list: Notifications, Branches, Feedback, Policies, Branch Change Request, About
- Sign out button (with confirmation prompt before calling signOut())
- Loading state for profile fetch (/agent/profile)
- Error state with retry

**P5-T2: branches.tsx — Complete**
- Fetch /agent/branches
- List of branches: name, address, hours, phone (tappable → tel: link), maps link (tappable → maps URL)
- Loading, empty, error states

**P5-T3: notifications.tsx — Complete**
- Fetch /agent/notifications (paginated if supported, else first 50)
- List: title, body, date, unread indicator (blue dot)
- Tap to mark read: POST /agent/notifications/{id}/read
- Mark all read button in header (or empty state action)
- Loading, empty ("No notifications yet"), error states

**P5-T4: feedback.tsx — Complete**
- Category picker: options like "General", "Payment Issue", "Technical", "Reward Query", "Other"
- Message field (required, 2000 char max with counter)
- Rating: 1-5 star selector (optional)
- Contact permission toggle: "Kezza may contact me about this feedback"
- Submit: POST /agent/feedback
- Success state: "Thanks! We've received your feedback."
- Loading, error states

**P5-T5: policies.tsx — Complete**
- Fetch /agent/legal-documents (active documents)
- List: title, version, type, status (accepted / not yet accepted)
- Tap to read: show document body in scrollable modal/bottom sheet
- Accept button at bottom of document view: POST /agent/legal-documents/{id}/accept
- Once accepted: show accepted badge and date
- Loading, empty, error states

**P5-T6: branch-change.tsx — Complete**
- Fetch active branches from /agent/branches for the picker
- Branch picker: select desired branch (exclude current branch)
- Reason field (required, 300 char max)
- Submit: POST /agent/branch-change-requests
- Success: "Your request has been submitted. An administrator will review it."
- Loading, error states
- Disable if a pending request already exists (check API error or pre-flight)

**P5-T7: about.tsx — Complete**
- App name, version (from expo-constants)
- Kezza company info placeholder
- Link to website (if available)
- Copyright line

**P5-T8: Hooks for account screens**
Add to appropriate feature hooks or create `src/features/account/hooks.ts`:
- `useAgentProfile()`
- `useBranches()`
- `useNotifications()`
- `useMarkNotificationRead(id)`
- `useLegalDocuments()`
- `useAcceptLegalDocument(id)`
- `useSubmitFeedback()`
- `useSubmitBranchChangeRequest()`

## Standards
- TypeScript strict, no `any`
- All states: loading, error, empty, populated
- Use existing theme and components
- DO NOT touch tab screens, task screens, auth screens, or backend files

## Commits
One commit per task: `git add -A` then `git commit -m "feat(mobile): P5-Tx description"`
Confirm: `git log -1 --oneline`

## When done
Post to @coordinator:
- Summary of each screen built
- Any TypeScript errors found
- `git log --oneline -8`
